data.name: Masbubah
data.gender_notes: Masbubah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic tradition, the name Masbubah refers to the one who responds to the call of Allah or to the needs of others. It is derived from the Arabic root 'sb', which means 'to respond' or 'to answer'. The name Masbubah carries the meaning “Answerer, Responder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masbubah usually hope their child will grow to embody answerer, responder and live with faith, good character and purpose.

By answering the call to faith and the needs of those around us, we are fulfilling our duty as Muslims and drawing closer to our Creator.
